title: Online Shopping Privacy Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Free template to request your personal data from online retailers. Protect your shopping privacy with this customizable letter template.
description: A comprehensive letter template to help you request access to your personal data, request data deletion, or opt-out of data sharing from online shopping platforms and e-commerce websites.

sections.heading: Letter Header
sections.content:
Date: [DATE]

To: Privacy Officer / Data Protection Team
[COMPANY_NAME]
[COMPANY_ADDRESS]

Subject: Privacy Rights Request - [REQUEST_TYPE]

placeholders.label: Type of Request
placeholders.defaultValue: Data Access Request / Data Deletion Request / Opt-Out Request

sections.heading: Personal Information
sections.content:
Dear Privacy Team,

I am writing to exercise my privacy rights regarding my personal information collected through your online shopping platform. Please find my account details below:

Full Name: [YOUR_NAME]
Email Address: [YOUR_EMAIL]
Account Number/Username: [ACCOUNT_INFO]
Registered Address: [YOUR_ADDRESS]

sections.heading: Privacy Request Details
sections.content:
I hereby request the following action regarding my personal data:

[Choose one or more options below:]

☐ ACCESS REQUEST: Please provide me with a copy of all personal information you have collected, processed, or stored about me, including:
- Purchase history and transaction records
- Browsing behavior and search history
- Personal preferences and recommendations
- Payment information (masked for security)
- Data shared with third parties

☐ DELETION REQUEST: Please delete all personal information associated with my account, including stored payment methods, purchase history, and behavioral tracking data.

☐ OPT-OUT REQUEST: Please remove me from:
- Marketing communications and promotional emails
- Data sharing with third-party partners
- Behavioral tracking and targeted advertising
- Price tracking and recommendation algorithms

sections.heading: Legal Basis and Timeline
sections.content:
This request is made under my privacy rights as established by:
☐ California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA)
☐ General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)
☐ Other applicable privacy laws: [SPECIFY_LAW]

Please respond to this request within the legally required timeframe (typically 30-45 days) and provide confirmation of the actions taken. If you require additional information to verify my identity, please contact me at [CONTACT_METHOD].

sections.heading: Closing
sections.content:
I appreciate your prompt attention to this matter and look forward to your response. Please confirm receipt of this request and provide a reference number for tracking purposes.

Thank you for respecting my privacy rights.

Sincerely,
[YOUR_SIGNATURE]
[YOUR_PRINTED_NAME]
[DATE]

useCases: Requesting access to personal data collected by online retailers
Asking e-commerce platforms to delete your shopping history and personal information
Opting out of targeted advertising based on shopping behavior
Stopping data sharing between retailers and third-party marketing companies
Removing personal information after closing an online shopping account
Requesting transparency about data collection practices
Exercising CCPA or GDPR rights with international shopping websites
